about.title: About
brand.guide_positioning_body: This workspace is for conversations and delivery evidence: left selects recent chats, center drives execution, right keeps documents, plan, evaluation, and file changes together.
brand.guide_usage_1: Choose the workspace folder and recent chat before sending anything.
brand.guide_usage_2: Send a concrete request with constraints and acceptance criteria.
brand.guide_usage_3: Watch the workspace while it runs: Spec checks understanding, Plan checks route, Goals and Evaluation catch drift, Files shows what changed.
brand.guide_usage_4: Titlebar menus configure workspace, model, tools, view, delivery channels, and diagnostics.

intro.headline: OpenCorvus workspace
intro.tagline: Start a conversation on the left. The workspace keeps the spec, plan, research, code changes, and delivery evidence in one place.
intro.mode.workflow.label: Plan and deliver
intro.mode.workflow.desc: For larger work: understand the request, design the route, break it into goals, execute, and verify with evidence.
intro.mode.build.label: Direct edit
intro.mode.build.desc: For focused fixes and Q&A: run one implementation path with the same workspace context and file evidence.
intro.agent.orchestrator.desc: Keeps the run coordinated: routes goals, watches failures, retries when evidence supports it, and preserves the budget.
intro.agent.requirements.desc: Turns the conversation into a clear brief: target user, scope, constraints, and acceptance bar.
intro.agent.design_analyst.desc: Reads existing code and references before implementation so the answer follows the local product shape.
intro.agent.architect.desc: Converts the brief into a practical build plan with dependencies and verification points.
intro.agent.build.desc: Edits files, runs tools, and iterates inside the selected workspace.
intro.agent.delivery.desc: Collects build, test, diff, and runtime evidence before the result is accepted.
intro.agent.integrity.desc: Checks that the final result still matches the original request and did not drift.
intro.hint: When work starts, each agent writes a visible card in the conversation stream.
